explanation: pthread_mutex_lock is a function in the POSIX threads library that locks a mutex object, ensuring that only one thread can access a protected section of code at a time. It is used to prevent race conditions, such as when multiple threads read from or write to the same shared resource like a file descriptor, which could lead to data corruption or inconsistent results if accessed concurrently.
